purpose: Sensor anomaly threshold calibration for heavy machinery (NOT for RAG vector search)

heat_dissipation_failure.physical_meaning: Poor air heat transfer while engine/pump runs at low RPM under load. Radiator core clogged or fan hydraulic slip.

power_failure.physical_meaning: Hydraulic motor or engine operating outside permissible mechanical power curve.

overstrain_failure.physical_meaning: Combined mechanical wear and extreme torque exceeding material yield strength.

tool_wear_failure.physical_meaning: Cumulative mechanical contact fatigue limit reached. Chisel or bucket tooth replacement required.
